QuestInfo.name: Anor's Request
QuestInfo.0: You were about to go to a different sanctum, but #p3000004# has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000004# must stay to protect the relic here, but he needs ingredients for his research. Defeat #o2400006# monsters at the #m400010300# near #m400040000# and bring him 40 of the #t4000710# items they carry.
QuestInfo.2: It seems that #p3000004# also asked Kaiser for help. What a sneak!

0.1: I gotta get my research knocked out, but I'm all out of ingredients. If I take off to get everything, my bosses are going to be all, 'Anor, why don't you ever take responsibility?' and 'Anor, you haven't been to work in three days!' It's lame!

yes.0: Cool, I just need like a good stock of #t4000710# parts and I'll be good. They're all the way over at the #m400010300#, but you're super fast and stuff, so it's cool.

no.0: No, don't leave me! You gotta help!

1.0: Nice! With that goofball Kaiser running my errands and you bringing me wings, I can nap for the rest of the afternoon. \r\n#L0##b(What did he say about Kaiser?)#l\n#k
1.1: Don't wrinkle up that cute nose of yours looking upset. Once I impress the bosses with these sweet potions, we can go out.

yes.0: I'm so good at delegating work. I should be a manager.

item.0: I need 40!  Just defeat the #o2400006# monsters at the #m400010300# and bring me their #t4000710# parts.
